desc: Analyze problem as threshold bipartite matching (top a fits bottom b iff 2a<=b) and note roles are not preassigned
Implement feasible(K): for i in range(K) require 2*A[i] <= A[N-K+i]; return True for K=0; prove the smallest-K-tops vs largest-K-bottoms characterization
Binary search the maximum K over [0, N//2] using feasible(K) (feasibility is monotone in K)
Write full program: read N and sorted A from stdin, compute answer, print only the integer to stdout; use 2*a<=b integer arithmetic
Test on all three samples (expect 3, 0, 6) plus edge cases (N=2 no pair, all equal, duplicates, N=5e5)
Provide a fallback distinct approach if binary-search check fails: scan descending with predecessor matching (Fenwick/segment tree) to verify max matching
